subject: 專業英文

essays.text: 請將下列英文譯為中文（含英文有底線的縮寫字）。（20 分）Survey of existing ships:For ships which are classed with other classification societies, such as ABS, BV, GL, LR,NK, DNV and have been surveyed in accordance with the requirements of their rules, weaccept the survey reports previously issued by other classification societies and maintaintheir survey status in principle. The survey items that are not yet due may be completedwhen they are due, whereas the surveys items already due shall be completed first. Ingeneral, a survey to the extent of an intermediate survey as specified in CR Rules is to beconducted, and the outstanding items from previous classification societies shall be dealtwith.

請將下列中文譯為英文。
①根據“1974 年海上人命安全國際公約”及其相關修訂案規定而執行檢驗，因海上人命安全國際公約範圍較廣，因此一般船舶須簽發五種證書如下：（10 分）
②貨船安全構造證書（3 分）
③貨船安全設備證書（3 分）
④貨船安全無線電證書（3 分）
⑤符合文件/安全管理證書（3 分）
⑥國際船舶保全證書（3 分）

請用英文解釋（說明）下列船舶用名詞：（每小題 5 分，共 25 分）
①deck crane
②electric mooring winch
③bilge keel
④deaerator
⑤volute
